alt: Rows of data/products.csv (SKU001 to SKU005) become JSON messages on the Kafka topic cocoindex-csv-rows, keyed by the first column; editing the SKU003 row in live mode produces only a new SKU003 message, and rpk topic consume shows each message's key and JSON value.

run.cmd: docker run -d --name redpanda -p 9092:9092 redpandadata/redpanda:latest redpanda start --mode dev-container --smp 1 --kafka-addr PLAINTEXT://0.0.0.0:9092 --advertise-kafka-addr PLAINTEXT://localhost:9092

run.note: Create the topic (CocoIndex never creates topics)
run.cmd: docker exec redpanda rpk topic create cocoindex-csv-rows

run.note: Produce every row, then keep watching ./data
In another terminal, read the topic
run.cmd: docker exec redpanda rpk topic consume cocoindex-csv-rows --num 10
